name: Esketamine
metabolism: CYP2B6/CYP3A4 N-demethylation forms noresketamine, followed by further CYP processing and glucuronidation. Elimination is mainly urinary as metabolites, with little unchanged parent drug.
summary: Esketamine is the S-enantiomer of ketamine and is used as a dissociative general anesthetic and an antidepressant. For depression, it is used under medical supervision for treatment-resistant depression and major depressive disorder with suicidal ideation or behavior.
